title: GrowthBook feature rows
description: A big airy section heading, then stacked product rows: a mono eyebrow with a small violet line icon, a large regular-weight heading, a short paragraph and a violet button on the left, a square rounded media panel on the right. A thin frame rule runs down the left with a multicolour light that travels down it as you scroll.
notes: each row has a square media slot (578×578 on desktop, 12px radius; 16px radius on phones); empty slots show soft gradient placeholders
the moving rail is CSS scroll-driven; static in browsers without it and with reduced motion
